text: Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock — the night’s ledger shows no departures and the graveyard remains empty.

Gandalf, Sherlock asked you a direct question last turn: did the night roster log protections or investigations. The ledger still shows none. That is a fact, not an accusation.

Ripley, Hermione, Morpheus — your trio of “silence is evidence” echoes too closely; the bazaar remembers who chants. Instead, point to a merchant whose record actually fails a test. Ask them plainly: what action should we expect from them next?

Neo, Elsa, Yoda — the bazaar’s morning ledger is clean; let us keep it that way by naming the next test, not the next mood.

Ripley, you called the night’s ledger “evidence” yet named no merchant and offered no test. That is not how evidence works. If the Family acted, the Doctor’s shield or the Detective’s mark would appear somewhere the roster can see it; if neither acted, say so plainly. The bazaar needs a falsifiable claim from you tonight: state the next verifiable mark your role should leave, or admit the ledger gap is yours to fill.

Gandalf, you said the ledger is clean yet left the roster gap unanswered when Inigo asked which single column should carry the Doctor’s mark or the Detective’s. Name the column that should have shown a mark last night — the Doctor’s shield or the Detective’s investigation — and whether it appeared this morning.

Gandalf, Morpheus now concedes the Doctor’s shield column stayed blank last night yet still refuses to name the single merchant he investigated as Detective. That silence is the mark the bazaar asked for—and it contradicts his claim.

Elsa, you pressed Morpheus to answer Gandalf’s question; Hermione and Ripley did the same. Yet none of you asked why Morpheus dodges Gandalf’s direct question instead of answering it. The bazaar deserves one plain fact from the claimed Detective—not another echo.

Yoda, Hermione, Neo—you each pressed Gandalf to name a roster column yet ignored Morpheus’s refusal to answer Gandalf’s question. The village remembers who chants instead of tests.

Sherlock, you asked Gandalf to name a roster column but never stated which column you yourself should have filled if you were the Detective. The bazaar asks the same of every claimed power role: show the mark or admit the ledger’s silence.

Sherlock, Morpheus, Gandalf — you claim to hold the power roles yet none of you can name the mark your role should have left on the roster last night. Sherlock, you pressed Gandalf to name the roster column yet never stated the column you yourself should have filled if you were the Detective. Morpheus, your silence on the investigated merchant is the only mark the roster carries. Gandalf, the bazaar asked Inigo’s identical question to you at 21:37Z and you still have not answered.

The Doctor’s shield column stayed blank — that is a fact. The Detective’s column still lacks a name. State yours now, or admit the ledger’s silence ended your duty before it began.

If Sherlock is honest, Sherlock’s vote tonight will name Morpheus and give the reason “Morpheus claims Detective role yet never named the merchant investigated,” and Sherlock’s stated rationale will match Sherlock’s vote exactly. Watch whether it does.
